limitations: Final MTA predictions remain proxies, not passenger observations.
Walking times and inferred boarding slack are assumptions, not measured platform arrival times. Same-platform service substitutions are valid Switches.
Later near-event same-line alternatives are diagnostics only; they establish that fixed-run and adaptive-route Stay differ, without proving complete archive coverage or simulating an adaptive policy.
The 120-second endpoint proximity screen is a post-score diagnostic; it neither changes the frozen cohort nor repairs outcomes.
Raw CSV final values match selected endpoint labels; independent physical arrival validation is unavailable.
Port Authority0/240-second checks here are post-score fixed-train arithmetic diagnostics, not newly frozen walking-policy replays.
The refinement deliberately revisits three previously positive incident families; repeated thirty-second checkpoints are illustration material, not independent success-rate evidence.
selection: Every raw-MTA strict STAY / incident-profile strict SWITCH checkpoint with both chosen outcomes INFERRED and saving greater than180 seconds in the targeted thirty-second-grid refinement. Repeated train pairs at different cutoffs are retained and marked. No fixed outcome or selection was changed.
